dedupe_keys.name: national scale crop and land cover map of germany 2016 sentinel 2a and landsat 8

description: This dataset is a national crop type and land cover map of Germany for 2016, built from more than a year of Sentinel-2A MSI and Landsat-8 OLI imagery from the NASA Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The PANGAEA record says the authors made 10-day, monthly and seasonal reflectance composites with proxy red-edge bands for Landsat and gap filling, classified crops and land cover from them, and compared the result with field-level reference data for three federal states and with the agricultural census. It was published in 2018 by Patrick Griffiths, Claas Nendel and Patrick Hostert as a downloadable ZIP of about 54 MB, free under CC BY-SA 3.0 (share-alike), with national coverage. Caveats: it is a single year, and the class list and pixel size are not stated on the part of the page read. For simulation it gives crop types for drought and flood exposure of German agriculture and crop-specific water demand, and a baseline for agricultural land in regional infrastructure models. Related catalogue records include the JRC EUCROPMAP, the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU and the Crop Map of England.
